item.title: FCC opening probe into 'The View' after appearance by Talarico
item.description: The Federal Communications Commission is opening an investigation into ABC's "The View" after Texas state Rep. item.title: Austin traffic: Closure to begin for NB I-35 frontage road north of Riverside Drive
item.description: TxDOT will soon be closing the northbound I-35 frontage road north of Riverside Drive.This is a long-term closure that will remain in place through 2029, TxDOT said.Starting on Monday, Feb. 16, crews will close access to the northbound I-35 frontage road just north of Riverside Drive. item.title: Texas A&M University-San Antonio adds 6 new varsity sports for 2026-27 school year
item.description: Texas A&M University-San Antonio will be adding six new varsity sports for the 2026-27 school year. The university said it is the largest expansion of its athletics program in its history.For the 2026-27 school year, the university will add men's and women's indoor and outdoor track and field, and men's and women's cross country. item.title: Deadly crash near Florence closes lane on SH 195
item.description: Troopers and deputies are investigating a deadly crash near Florence. Texas DPS said on Monday, Feb. 9, troopers and WilCo deputies responded to a deadly crash on SH 195 near CR 138. The Williamson County Sheriff's Office said the crash happened in the Florence area. One lane of SH 195 remains closed while officials continue to work the scene.
